newsitem.title: USA: Action intends 1.9 mln secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: Action intends 1.9 mln secondary offering.

text.p: Action Performance Cos Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 1.9 million shares of its common stock in a secondary offering.
Proceeds will be used to pay debt from recent acquisitions and general corporate purposes, including working capital and possible new acquisitions, Action said.
The company said it plans to selll 1.5 million shares and anticpates certain stockholders will sell remaining 400,000 shares.
